Name: KT_TriggersAndroid
Author: kazutopi1
Description:
[b]Adds 3 new custom Triggers for Data/TriggerActions for Android users to utilize.

[/b][b]kazutopi1.KT_ButtonAPressed:[/b] Raised when player is currently holding an item and virtual button A(Left) is pressed/tapped.

[b]kazutopi1.KT_ButtonBPressed:[/b] Raised when player is currently holding an item and virtual button B(Right) is pressed/tapped.

[b]kazutopi1.KT_OnTap:[/b] Raised when the current movement control is `Tap-to-move & Auto-Attack` and the tile the player standing in is pressed/tapped while currently holding an item.


[url=https://github.com/kazutopi1/KT_TriggersAndroid/tree/main]Source Code[/url]
